The '''Idolia system''' was a part of the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as [[Idolian fever]].<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Idolian fever]]|system=Idolia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Idolia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
